input_description: AHF (Amiga Halo Finder) halo catalogs (.AHF_halos) combined with the MergerTree progenitor files (.AHF_croco, .AHF_mtree_idx). ASCII format, GIZMO simulation B25_N512_CDM_3LPT: 25 Mpc/h box, 512^3 particles, 52 snapshots (z=29 to z=0), 5.3 million halos across 242,416 trees.
issues_encountered: AHF AngMom columns (Lx, Ly, Lz) are a unit direction vector, not the specific angular momentum. Peebles lambda spin parameter is stored separately.
hostHaloID=0 in the AHF output encodes two distinct cases: the field halo (no host) and a missing/unknown host, requiring careful disambiguation.
AHF ID encoding uses the SUSSING2013 scheme in both MPI and non-MPI variants (snap*1e16+rank*1e10+idx vs snap*1e12+idx); the correct variant must be auto-detected per file.
SubhaloSpin magnitude reconstruction requires combining lambda, Mhalo, and Rhalo from separate AHF columns, since no specific angular momentum column is written directly.

No GIZMO cosmological parameter file was initially found for the simulation; cosmological parameters were inferred from particle mass before being confirmed from B25_N512_CDM_3LPT_z39_adapt.gizmo_parameters.
resolutions: Reconstructed specific angular momentum as |j| = lambda * sqrt(2 * G * Mhalo * Rhalo_Mpc_h) * 1000 [(kpc/h)(km/s)] using G=4.3009e-9 (Mpc/h)(km/s)^2(Msun/h)^-1, confirmed from AHF source ahf_halos.c:4952.

Confirmed from AHF source ahf_io.c that halos[i].hostHalo < 0 (internally -1, i.e. field halo) is written as 0. hostHaloID=0 always means field/central halo; non-zero hostHaloID is a SUSSING2013 parent ID.
Auto-detection implemented in _decode_snap_id(): try MPI encoding (floor(ID/1e16)); if result is 0 < snap < 10000, use it; otherwise fall back to non-MPI (floor(ID/1e12)).
Formula for SubhaloSpin reconstruction derived directly from AHF source code (ahf_halos.c:4946-4960). G value confirmed from unit analysis (Mpc/h * (km/s)^2 / (Msun/h)).
Confirmed exact cosmological parameters (Omega_M=0.3099, OmegaLambda=0.6901, h=0.67742) from input/gizmo-tidal/B25_N512_CDM_3LPT_z39_adapt.gizmo_parameters. SAGE parameter file updated.
